name: insilode
description: Insilode: a harness-first code editor. Call-flow canvas, terminal agents with live status, and tools for Claude Code harness engineering.

scripts.check: npm run arch && npm run test:update && npm run test:e2e-unit && npm run semgrep
scripts.arch: depcruise editor/extensions/flow-view/src editor/extensions/flow-view/mcp editor/extensions/flow-agent/src editor/extensions/flow-harness/src editor/extensions/flow-import/src ui/src site/src protocol -c .dependency-cruiser.cjs && node --test "test/arch/*.test.mjs"
scripts.arch:graph: depcruise editor/extensions/flow-view/src editor/extensions/flow-view/mcp editor/extensions/flow-agent/src editor/extensions/flow-harness/src editor/extensions/flow-import/src ui/src site/src protocol -c .dependency-cruiser.cjs -T archi
